HandoffRequirement.description:
Policy outcome for a case, decided by banking-core and never by the model.

When the level is NONE nothing else is set; otherwise the priority,
department and reason a handoff for this case must carry are all set.

department.description: Department the handoff must be routed to; unset when level is NONE

priority.description: Minimum queue priority of the handoff; unset when level is NONE

reason.description: Categorized reason the handoff must carry; unset when level is NONE

HandoffRequirement.title: HandoffRequirement

HandoffRequirementLevel.description:
How strongly banking-core policy asks for a human on this case (ADR-0003).

RECOMMENDED is advisory. REQUIRED is enforced: the turn engine creates the
handoff itself when the model has not.
HandoffRequirementLevel.title: HandoffRequirementLevel
